title: The Map of Abrahamic Texts
source: The Map of Sacred Texts.mhtml (artifact fea77718) — extracted 2026-07-28; editorial artifact, never regenerated silently

zones.name: Tanakh — the Hebrew Bible
zones.subtitle: 24 books (39 individual) · shared spine
zones.blurb: The whole Tanakh is public-domain in English via the JPS 1917 translation. This is the shared spine — the same books as the Christian Old Testament.

zones.name: Mishnah
zones.subtitle: 6 orders · 63 tractates
zones.blurb: The 63 tractates of the Mishnah. Danby’s 1933 English is the standard — worldwide-PD in life+70 terms but under the US copyright clock until 2029, so amber (Pirkei Avot has older PD translations).

zones.name: Talmud & Tosefta
zones.blurb: Gemara — the great Aramaic analysis of the Mishnah. The one worldwide-PD English is Rodkinson’s (partial, weak); the standard Soncino is ©, and the flagship Steinsaltz is CC-BY-NC (free but non-commercial).

chips.name: Babylonian Talmud (Bavli) — Gemara on 37 of the 63 tractates

zones.name: Midrash & Targum
zones.blurb: Homiletic & legal expansion of scripture, and the Aramaic Targums (Etheridge’s Targums are green).

zones.name: Halakhah & thought
zones.blurb: The legal codes and the classics of medieval Jewish philosophy.

zones.name: Kabbalah & Liturgy
zones.blurb: The mystical tradition and the prayer book.

zones.name: Old Testament
zones.subtitle: 39 + deuterocanon · shared spine
zones.blurb: The Christian Old Testament — the same books as the Jewish Tanakh, reordered — plus the deuterocanon of the Catholic & Orthodox canons. All public-domain (KJV, ASV, Douay-Rheims).

zones.name: New Testament
zones.subtitle: 27 books
zones.blurb: The 27 books, agreed by all traditions. All public-domain in English many times over.

zones.name: Apostolic Fathers & Patristics
zones.subtitle: ANF 10 + NPNF 28 vols · all PD
zones.blurb: The greatest public-domain shelf in the archive — the Ante-Nicene and Nicene & Post-Nicene Fathers (Roberts–Donaldson / Schaff & Wace), enumerated by author. Titles from the CCEL contents (public-domain text; own structure).

zones.name: Creeds & Councils
zones.blurb: The rules of faith and the councils that fixed them — all public-domain (Schaff, Creeds of Christendom; NPNF 2.14).

zones.name: Apocrypha & Pseudepigrapha
zones.blurb: The books outside the canon — public-domain via M.R. James (1924) and R.H. Charles (1913). The one trap: Nag Hammadi is ancient but its English translations are modern ©.

zones.name: The Qurʾān
zones.subtitle: 114 suras · Arabic is canonical
zones.blurb: The whole Qurʾān is public-domain in English via Sale (1734), Rodwell (1861), Palmer (SBE, 1880) and — newly, since 1 Jan 2026 — Pickthall (1930). Only the Arabic is doctrinally canonical; these are "interpretations."

zones.name: Hadith — the Sunna
zones.subtitle: Arabic ancient · English all ©
zones.blurb: Every canonical Hadith collection exists in English only under modern copyright (Muhsin Khan, Siddiqui, Darussalam) — the Arabic is ancient/PD, the English is not.
